Start a loop iteration.

**Status:** Can't run yet (Coming soon): the node is listed under **Can't run yet** in the palette and cannot be added to a graph.

Marks the beginning of a loop. Data flows through the loop body and returns to Loop End, which feeds back to Loop Start.
